community.blurb: You get sworn at by an under-8. Respect.

community.label: Guest on local radio
community.blurb: You play 'Three Lions' twice. Nobody complains.

community.label: Open the new corner shop
community.blurb: Big scissors. Ribbon. Free scratchcard. You win £2.

community.label: Play in a charity match
community.blurb: You're marked by a soap star and a weatherman. You score four. They'll never forgive you.

staff.name: Personal trainer
staff.perk: Faster skill gains, slower decline after 30

staff.name: Nutritionist
staff.oops: Puts you on a diet of exclusively beetroot. Everything is purple now.

staff.name: Personal chef
staff.oops: Sells the contents of your fridge to a tabloid

staff.name: Physio
staff.perk: Fewer injuries, and quicker recovery when you do get one
staff.oops: Has a theory about magnets. You're wearing 14 of them.

staff.name: Sports psychologist
staff.perk: Better form, fewer slumps after bad games
staff.oops: Is writing a book about you. Chapter 3 is called 'The Kebab Years'.

staff.name: Personal assistant
staff.perk: Juggles your diary: once a week, one activity doesn't use up your day
staff.oops: Knows all your secrets. Has started hinting about a pay rise.

staff.name: Financial adviser
staff.perk: Savings grow, warns you before money gets tight, keeps the loan sharks away
staff.oops: The dodgy one runs off with your savings funds

staff.name: PR manager
staff.perk: Spins scandals (less honour and fan damage), keeps your digs out of the papers, fewer trolls
staff.oops: Overspins a non-story into a story

staff.name: Driver and security
staff.oops: Crashes the Bentley. Into another Bentley.

staff.name: Nanny
staff.perk: Keeps the family happy when you're busy (and helps run the house if there are no kids yet)
staff.oops: Your partner thinks you're 'too close'. You're not. You've spoken twice.
